column3: Menardi Atropos
Menardi? What are you doing\nhere?{end_wait}
Hmm? How do you know my\nname?{end_wait}
What do you mean? Don't you\nrecognize us?{end_wait}
Wait, Garet. Something's\ndifferent about her.{end_wait}
Perhaps she's Menardi\nfrom another world.{end_wait}
Another Menardi? How\namusing.{end_wait}
Regardless, it makes little\ndifference to me.{end_wait}
Do you know how you ended\nup here?{end_wait}
No. I've been wondering\nabout that myself.{end_wait}
Still, it would be foolish\nto let such an opportunity\ngo to waste.{end_wait}
What are you talking about?{end_wait}
An entire world filled with\npeople I've never met...{end_wait}
I wonder how many\nsacrifices this world has\nto offer.{end_wait}
Sacrifices?! You're going\nto take innocent lives?{end_wait}
Innocent or otherwise,\nthey'll serve the same\npurpose.{end_wait}
Isaac, we can't let her\nleave this place.{end_wait}
Agreed. We'll stop her\nhere.{end_wait}
How considerate of you to\noffer yourselves.{end_wait}
Four sacrifices will do for\nnow.{end_wait}
Tch... I underestimated\nyou.{end_wait}
We won't let you carry out\nyour plans.{end_wait}
Such a promising world,\ntoo. What a disappointment.{end_wait}
You're still thinking about\nsacrifices?!{end_wait}
Did you expect me to change\nmy mind?{end_wait}
How can someone's life mean\nso little to you?{end_wait}
You ask such strange\nquestions.{end_wait}
Hey! Where'd she go?!{end_wait}
I can't sense her presence\nanymore.{end_wait}
Do you think she's returned\nto her own world?{end_wait}
It's possible, but there's\nno way to know for certain.{end_wait}
We should remain vigilant.\nShe might not be the only\none who's ended up here.{end_wait}
